title: ORDER BY sorts by each key in turn, each ascending or descending
query: EVALUATE ALL ( Product[Category], Product[Color] ) ORDER BY Product[Category] ASC, Product[Color] DESC

source.quote: Every column can be sorted in an ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) way. The default is ASC.
source.supports: the page shows this query shape: ALL of two columns ordered ASC then DESC

source.quote: Using two or more columns arguments, ALL returns all the unique combinations of values in multiple columns.
source.supports: ALL of two columns returns the combinations that exist

derivation: Combinations in Product: (Vehicles, Red) Bike, (Accessories, Red) Helmet, (Accessories, Blue) Lock, (Vehicles, Green) Scooter. Category ascending: Accessories then Vehicles. Within each, color descending: Red before Blue, Red before Green.
